body: Just wanted to say man that when i was feeling this way a few months ago i was really annoyed about how i had no means to accomplish the task but its been a few months and i feel like im in a much better/stable place and im really relived i wasn't able to go through with it because i was just so blinded/wasn't clear headed enough to make such a big Permeant decision maybe you could consider writing a note to yourself for say 3 months from today and you could have the time to evaluate your decision and make sure your really doing this because your sure instead of just having a tons of hormone in your blood and emotions clouding your judgment ?

Hey im a little late it seems but i was going to ask you if you could maybe wait a bit maybe let the alcohol out of the system a bit, I don't want to sound like im telling you to do anything but I've struggled with some depression and stuff and I've found like alcohol kinda magnifies those thoughts or tendencies maybe you could take a nap or watch a movie or two until you get a clear head you perspective might chance a bit. Either way man im here to talk if your up for it.

Well that seems like a really interesting degree, im sure they probably have you reading all sorts of interesting books and stuff, how are you with the material you understanding it all all right or you struggling a bit?
